method: The population is merged MessagePack-CSharp pull requests from 2025-05-11 through 2026-11-11. SZZ marked a source line as escaped when a later fix PR changed a line blamed to an earlier merged PR; the seed-fixed sample contains 3 escaped PRs and 3 controls because only 14 of 36 merged PRs met the size/source filter. Each selected PR was run at its merge-time base parent and head through the unchanged pipeline stages in an isolated snapshot, then scored against the mapped fix lines.
caveats: Models may have seen these PRs and fixes in training, so detection is an upper bound.
SZZ labels are noisy: a later change to a line is not proof that the earlier line was buggy.
The sample is six PRs because only 14 PRs were eligible in this one repository and period.
This is one .NET repository and stack, with old commits that may not build.
Selection is constrained by the short recent history and seeded shuffle; it is not representative of all GitHub PRs.
One control had a sandbox restore infrastructure error and is reported as failed, not as a clean run.
